crossRefs.note: They said, “We, your servants, are twelve brothers, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and behold, the youngest…

people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

translations.web: We are twelve brothers, sons of our father; one is no more, and the youngest is today with our father in the land of Canaan.’
translations.bsb: We are twelve brothers, sons of one father. One is no more, and the youngest is now with our father in the land of Canaan.’
translations.kjv: We be twelve brethren, sons of our father; one is not, and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan.
translations.asv: we are twelve brethren, sons of our father; one is not, and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan.
